pedidos.pedido: F092: 'Canada shall, when called upon…' (Art. IV(3))
F209: 'is not currently defined in the Treaty' (CRS, nota 39)
F093, F210: 'pre-planned FRM operations … would be distinct from and in no way' (nota dos EUA, 22/11/2024)
F211 (L): o tratado é a promessa, o acordo é o espaço
F094 (L): certeza (a frase do canal; Lucas: 'Fica')

grafias_do_espelho: NO NUMBER SAYS WHEN (a forma é do redator: anotação escrita)
Source: Columbia River Treaty, Art. IV(3)
texto_aprovado: So yes, the United States can call on Canada in a flood. And no number says when. Under the deal, it pays so the room is already there, call or no call. The treaty is the promise. The deal is the room. What the United States is buying is certainty.
